title: Gatchalian: Chinese envoy’s remark is ‘undiplomatic, uncalled for’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian criticized Chinese Ambassador to Manila Jing Quan on Friday for saying that China can “easily win” in a military dispute against the Philippines. “It is not correct that a foreigner inside our country is threatening us. That’s undiplomatic and uncalled for,” Gatchalian said in an interview at the Senate.
